member.name: T:LiteGraph.McpServer.Classes.LiteGraphMcpErrors
member.summary: Translates exceptions raised by LiteGraph MCP tool handlers into MCP protocol errors, so clients receive a specific JSON-RPC error code and a readable message instead of Voltaic's generic "-32603 Internal error". All members are stateless and thread-safe.

member.summary: JSON-RPC invalid-params code (-32602), used for argument errors and REST 400 responses.

member.summary: JSON-RPC internal-error code (-32603), used for unexpected failures; the message still carries the cause.

member.name: F:LiteGraph.McpServer.Classes.LiteGraphMcpErrors.UpstreamErrorCode
member.summary: Server-defined code (-32000) for REST failures that have no more specific mapping (for example 5xx responses).

member.name: F:LiteGraph.McpServer.Classes.LiteGraphMcpErrors.UnauthorizedCode
member.summary: Server-defined code (-32001) for REST 401 Unauthorized responses.

member.name: F:LiteGraph.McpServer.Classes.LiteGraphMcpErrors.ForbiddenCode
member.summary: Server-defined code (-32003) for REST 403 Forbidden responses.

member.name: F:LiteGraph.McpServer.Classes.LiteGraphMcpErrors.NotFoundCode
member.summary: Server-defined code (-32004) for REST 404 Not Found responses and missing records.

member.name: F:LiteGraph.McpServer.Classes.LiteGraphMcpErrors.ConflictCode
member.summary: Server-defined code (-32009) for REST 409 Conflict responses.

member.name: M:LiteGraph.McpServer.Classes.LiteGraphMcpErrors.Translate(System.Exception)
member.summary: Translate an exception raised by a tool handler into an MCP protocol exception. An existing is returned unchanged; wrapper exceptions are unwrapped first.
member.param: Exception raised by the handler; must not be null.
member.returns: An MCP protocol exception with a specific code, a readable message, and structured data.

member.name: M:LiteGraph.McpServer.Classes.LiteGraphMcpErrors.CodeForStatus(System.Int32)
member.summary: Map an HTTP status code returned by the LiteGraph REST server to a JSON-RPC error code. 400 maps to -32602, 401 to -32001, 403 to -32003, 404 to -32004, 409 to -32009, any other status to -32000.

member.name: T:LiteGraph.McpServer.Classes.LiteGraphMcpRegistrationExtensions
member.summary: Registration helpers that wrap LiteGraph MCP handlers so any exception they raise is translated by into a specific MCP protocol error rather than a generic internal error. Methods registered on the TCP and WebSocket servers return their value as a tool call result ({"content":[{"type":"text","text":...}]}), the same shape tools/call returns over HTTP, because every JSON-RPC result must be a JSON object. Registration is not thread-safe; register tools before starting the servers.
